idea: A cinematic short film: a lone lighthouse keeper on a remote, storm-battered island wakes before dawn, climbs the spiral staircase of the old lighthouse, and battles the wind to light the great lamp just as a cargo ship appears through the rain on the horizon. Close-ups of weathered hands, sea spray over the railing, and the rotating beam cutting through the storm.
user_requirement: No more than 3 scenes, at most 4 shots per scene. Photorealistic, no on-screen text.
style: Cinematic, moody, natural light, 35mm film look
